name: Glow Reader
summary: Floating-text book reader for Rokid AI Glasses with no glowing background, just words
description: Glow Reader displays floating words on Rokid AI Glasses without a glowing background. It supports EPUB, PDF, TXT, and Markdown with multiple reading modes and a companion phone app for remote control and AI summaries.
author: karlua86

releases.notes:
Tested in extreme darkness on real glasses:

**Close-the-book is now TRULY see-through.** In v1.4, a closed book still left a very faint grey veil in total darkness (the display panel was on, showing black). v1.5 powers the panel down: brightness drops to zero instantly and the display is allowed to sleep, exactly like the glasses native idle state.

What to expect:
- Double-tap closes the book. A faint veil fades out over ~5 seconds as the panel sleeps, then the glass is completely clear.
- Double-tap reopens at your exact position. If the display had fully slept, double-tap twice (first wakes the screen, second reopens).
- While closed, all other taps and swipes are ignored.

**Files:** GlowReader-v1.5.apk = glasses (new), GlowRemote-v1.4.apk = Android phone (unchanged). Install over the old version - nothing is lost.

releases.notes:
Two quality-of-life updates, both tested on real glasses:

**Close the book (glasses):**
- Double-tap the temple while reading: the display goes COMPLETELY invisible - you stay in the book, position kept, auto-play paused. Perfect for when someone talks to you.
- Double-tap again to reopen exactly where you were.
- While closed, taps and swipes do nothing, so you cannot light the display by accident.
- Z key or the phone app button do the same. Note: double-tap no longer exits to the library - use the phone Library button or B key for that.

**AI summary lengths (phone):**
- Choose Short (1-2 sentences per chapter), Medium (~150 words) or Long (~400 words).
- Each version saves under its own name, so you can keep all three per book.

**Files:** GlowReader-v1.4.apk = glasses, GlowRemote-v1.4.apk = Android phone. Update by installing over the old version - nothing is lost.

releases.notes:
What is new since v1.0:

**Glow Remote (phone):**
- AI summary of the current book: chapter-by-chapter, in the book language, using YOUR OWN API key (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Claude) - the finished summary lands in the glasses library as a readable book
- Manage / delete books on the glasses from the phone
- Simplified remote: one Back / Play-Pause / Forward row that works in every mode

**Glow Reader (glasses):**
- Low-light mode fixed: now applies on every screen, and dims the text as a guaranteed fallback
- Words-per-minute always visible in a status line at the bottom, in all 5 modes
- Book text can no longer overlap the status line
- Books sent from the phone are stored in the shared Books folder: they survive even an app uninstall
- Updating the app never loses books, positions, highlights or settings - just install the new APK over the old one

**Files:** GlowReader-v1.3.apk = glasses, GlowRemote-v1.2.apk = Android phone.

Big update: the phone app now mirrors the book open on the glasses!

**New in Glow Remote (phone):**
- 📑 Reader view: full book text on your phone, auto-follows the glasses position
- Table of contents dropdown — pick a chapter, the glasses jump there
- Position slider + double-tap anywhere in the text to send the glasses there
- 🔖 Bookmarks (add / jump / delete)
- ✨ Select text to highlight — shows yellow on the phone, brighter + underlined on the glasses

**New in Glow Reader (glasses):**
- Chapter extraction (EPUB chapters; detected headings in TXT/PDF)
- Highlight rendering + navigation/highlight/bookmark API for the phone app
- Reopening a book always resumes at your last position

**Files:**
- **GlowReader-v1.0.apk** — install on the Rokid AI Glasses
- **GlowRemote-v1.0.apk** — install on your Android phone

Both apps must be v1.0 for the reader sync to work.

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About Glow Reader
Glow Reader is a book reader app for Rokid AI Glasses that shows only floating words with no glowing background block, providing a truly invisible background for comfortable night reading.

## Key Features
- Supports EPUB, PDF (reflowed), TXT, and Markdown formats
- Five reading modes: page flip, RSVP (word-by-word), teleprompter auto-scroll, sentence-by-sentence, and paragraph-by-paragraph
- "Close the book" gesture: double-tap temple to power down display to full invisibility while keeping reading position
- Adjustable text brightness and display area for low light conditions
- Full-lines-only rendering to avoid half-cut words
- Persistent settings and reading position per book
- Books auto-appear from the glasses' Download folder or can be pushed via phone
- AI summary feature via companion phone app using your own API key

## Controls
- Glasses temple touchpad: single tap to play/pause, swipe to turn page, double-tap to close/reopen book
- Compatible with Bluetooth keyboard/mouse for navigation
- Companion phone app (Glow Remote) offers remote control, live settings, and book transfer over WiFi

## Requirements
- Rokid AI Glasses with WiFi enabled
- Rokid Manager installed
- Companion phone app for remote features (optional)

For more details and downloads, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/karlua86/glow-reader).
